obernants.operator: Let U={(A,t,k): sorted A, 0<=k<=len(A)}. R is the forward cut relation. U minus R consists exactly of k with an earlier element >=t or a later element <t. Candidate source-derived exact characterization under preconditions; bounded oracle evidence, no general machine proof.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Conditional source-derived relation; bounded correspondence only, prospective details explicitly identified.
